summary: Nvni Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, announcing the appointment of Marco Aurélio Leone Fernandes as an independent director, effective July 27, 2026. The filing also discloses a July 28, 2026, Nasdaq notice of non-compliance with Listing Rule 5605 (audit committee composition), granting a cure period until November 18, 2025. The appointment of Mr. Leone restored compliance. This is a board composition event tied to a regulatory compliance issue, not a forced departure or routine proxy matter. No deal terms are present, as this is a governance and compliance filing.
